problems.forbidden: Your role may not do this. Ask a colleague with the right permission, or an administrator.

conflict.what: There is already an open request of this kind on this policy term.
conflict.fix: Finish or discard the open request first, then start again.

POL-ERR-EFFDATE-LIMIT.what: The effective date is outside the dates your role may choose.
POL-ERR-EFFDATE-LIMIT.fix: Pick a date inside the permitted range. A change dated earlier than today needs an underwriter.

POL-ERR-OUT-OF-SEQUENCE.what: A later transaction already exists on this term, so a change cannot take effect before it.
POL-ERR-OUT-OF-SEQUENCE.fix: Choose an effective date on or after the latest transaction shown in the policy file. Backdated corrections are not available yet.

POL-ERR-PREEMPTED.what: Someone else changed this policy after you started, so your request is no longer based on the current policy.
POL-ERR-PREEMPTED.fix: Go back to the policy file, check what changed, and start the request again.

POL-ERR-AFTER-CANCELLATION.what: The policy is cancelled from an earlier date, so nothing can take effect after that.
POL-ERR-AFTER-CANCELLATION.fix: Open the policy file to see the cancellation. A cancelled policy cannot be changed.

POL-ERR-ILLEGAL-TRANSITION.what: The policy term is not in a state where this action is allowed.
POL-ERR-ILLEGAL-TRANSITION.fix: Only a term that is scheduled or in force can be changed or cancelled. Check the status in the policy file.

POL-ERR-REBASE-REQUIRED.what: The policy changed after the offer was made, so the offer no longer matches it.
POL-ERR-REBASE-REQUIRED.fix: Issue the offer again, then record the acceptance.

POL-ERR-STALE.what: Another screen saved this request after you opened it.
POL-ERR-STALE.fix: Calculate the preview again; your entries are kept.

POL-ERR-HUMAN-CONFIRMATION-REQUIRED.what: The action needs your explicit confirmation.
POL-ERR-HUMAN-CONFIRMATION-REQUIRED.fix: Tick the confirmation box in the dialog and confirm again.

preview.refundHelp: Premium only; see the tax lines for what is not refunded.
preview.additionalDue: Additional amount due from the customer
preview.neutral: No change in the amount due
preview.neutralHelp: The change does not alter the premium.
preview.provisionalBody: At least one tax line follows a rule whose legal status is not settled (for example insurance premium tax is not refunded on cancellation, pending a legal opinion). The figures can change once the rule is confirmed.

reasons.when: Choose an effective date inside the permitted range to continue.
reasons.vehicle: Complete the required vehicle fields to continue.
reasons.preview: Calculate the premium preview for the current entries.
reasons.noChange: Change at least one vehicle detail, or replace the vehicle.
reasons.vehicleValue: The vehicle value is required because Own damage is covered.
reasons.stale: The entries changed after the preview. Calculate it again.
reasons.referred: The change is referred to underwriting and cannot be applied yet.

notChangeable.title: This policy cannot be changed
notChangeable.body: Only a policy term that is scheduled or in force can be changed. Check the status in the policy file.

when.title: When does the change take effect?

when.dateHelp: Today means from now on. Athens time.
when.locked: The change has been started, so the date is fixed.
when.failed: The change could not be started

vehicle.editHelp: Change the technical and rating details of the insured vehicle. The plate, make and model stay as they are.
vehicle.replaceHelp: Enter the new vehicle. The covers move to it and the old vehicle is removed, as one change.

preview.failed: The premium preview could not be calculated
preview.staleTitle: The preview is out of date

preview.emptyBody: Calculate to see what the change does to the premium before anything is applied.
preview.noPreviewBody: The system returned no servicing preview for this request. Try again, or report it with the trace id.

confirm.noQuoteBody: Go back and calculate the premium preview for your current entries.
confirm.gateFailedBody: A check before applying did not pass. Nothing was changed on the policy.

dialog.body: The change takes effect on {date}. Total effect: {effect}. This is recorded on the policy and cannot be undone here.
dialog.check: I have checked the preview and the customer agrees to the change.

bound.title: The change is applied
bound.body: It takes effect on {date}. Billing and finance receive the premium difference.

notCancellable.title: This policy cannot be cancelled
notCancellable.body: Only a policy term that is scheduled or in force can be cancelled. Check the status in the policy file.

request.title: Cancellation request

request.reasonRequired: Choose the reason for the cancellation.
request.nowHelp: Effective from the moment of the request. The refund covers the unused days.
request.flatHelp: Flat cancellation from the term start: the whole written premium is credited.
request.requestRefHelp: Message or document id of the customer’s request. No personal data.

kinds.flatInForce: Flat cancellation is only possible before the term starts.

confirm.failed: The cancellation could not be completed

dialog.title: Cancel this policy?
dialog.body: The policy is cancelled from the moment of the request. Refund due: {refund}. This cannot be undone here.
dialog.check: I have checked the refund and the customer has asked for the cancellation.

bound.title: The policy is cancelled
bound.body: The refund is passed to billing, which pays it out.

renew.title: Renewal

renew.emptyBody: Use Renew now to rate the next term. You see the premium and any referral before you make an offer.

create.failed: The renewal could not be started

rated.title: Renewal premium
rated.body: The next term is rated with the product version valid at its start.
rated.referredBody: An underwriter must decide before an offer can be made.
